installCommand: if [ -f apps/web/package.json ]; then npm install --include=dev --prefix apps/web; elif [ -f ../web/package.json ]; then npm install --include=dev --prefix ../web; else echo 'web package.json not found'; exit 1; fi
buildCommand: if [ -f apps/web/package.json ]; then npm --prefix apps/web run build -- --outDir ../../dist; elif [ -f ../web/package.json ]; then npm --prefix ../web run build -- --outDir ../api/dist; else echo 'web package.json not found'; exit 1; fi
